_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Mɛlɩya ɖɩ Snake kɛ {width}×{height} tɛɛ lɩbʊ.
Ɖɩna ɖɩ kɛ snake {player_id} kɛ. Labɩyɛ taa: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (aɖɩ w/s/a/d).
Ɖɩlabɩyɛ: ɖɩwɛɛ ɖɩ-tɛɛ kɩkɩŋ lɛɛlɛɛ aɖɩ ɖɩwɛɛ ɖɩ-tɛɛ kɩŋ lɛɛlɛɛ aɖɩ kɩyɔɔ kɩpɩndɩ (ɖɩ-tɛɛ lɛɛlɛɛ tɔm {max_turns}).

board.after_moves: Ɛjaɖɛ nɖɩ ɖɩ-taa palɩza ŋgbɛyɛ ńɖɩ yɔ: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Wɔɖɩyɛ {player_id} kʊyɩ kɛ pɩyɛɛ kʊyɩmɩŋ lɛɣtʊ.

outcome.survived_win: Aleɣya laɖʋ {player_id} pɩzaa nɛ ɛɖɔkɩ e-nesi, lalaa tɩŋa sɩba.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Kʋñɔŋ ŋgʋ kɩ-taa lɛ, ɖʋm tɩŋa sɩba.
outcome.outlived: Ɛ-ɛyʋ kɩbɩnʋ kaacaɣ wezuu nɛ pɩɖɛɛ lalaa.
outcome.turn_limit: Ye ŋtalɩ hɔɔlʋʋ ŋgʋ kɩ-taa pɩwɛɛ se ŋpɩsɩ yɔ, mbʋ pɩhaɣ waɖɛ nɛ ña ɖɔɖɔ ŋkpaɣ lɩmaɣza.
